title: Sachs Equations and Plane Waves, V: Ward, Fourier, and Heisenberg Symmetry on Plane Waves
summary: This article studies wave equations and their solutions on plane wave spacetimes of arbitrary dimension, developing the interplay among three structural layers: the Ward progressing-wave representation of solutions to the scalar wave equation, the Fourier analysis of the Heisenberg group naturally associated to the plane wave, and the Schrödinger propagator governing the evolution of initial data.
